Welcome to the official Ekico YouTube channel.

Ekico develops innovative technologies to help veterinary professionals objectively assess animal locomotion and monitor treatment outcomes.

On this channel, you’ll discover:

* 🐶 Tendiboots™ Canine Gait Analysis demonstrations and tutorials
* 📊 Objective gait analysis in everyday veterinary practice
* 🩺 Clinical cases in orthopedics, neurology, rehabilitation, and sports medicine
* 🎓 Educational videos, webinars, and expert insights
* 🚀 Product updates and new features

Our mission is to make objective gait analysis simple and practical for every veterinary clinic.

Whether you are a veterinarian, rehabilitation therapist, physiotherapist, researcher, or veterinary student, our videos will help you better understand canine locomotion and improve patient follow-up through objective measurements.

Learn more about Tendiboots™:
🌐 https://ekico.fr

Subscribe to stay up to date with the latest innovations in veterinary gait analysis.
